jobs.occupation: Procurement Associate (m/f/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.description:
At KWS Berlin, we are looking for a Procurement Associate (m/f/d) to support our team in procurement operations, internal stakeholder management, and process optimization. In this role, you will gain valuable insights into purchasing processes, contribute to cross-functional collaboration, and help drive operational excellence across our organization.

This is a fixed-term position (24 months) with 38 hours per week, based in Berlin.

Your responsibilities:

- Process purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and contracts for goods and services in accordance with defined scopes and service level agreements (SLAs).
- Manage procurement-related requests from internal stakeholders through our ticketing system while ensuring compliance with agreed SLAs.
- Support request-for-quotation (RFQ) processes and execute tactical purchasing activities within defined spend categories and approval thresholds.
- Analyze spending patterns across supported KWS legal entities and identify opportunities for catalog implementation and process improvements.
- Support the delivery of end-user training and enable stakeholders to effectively utilize procurement tools and processes.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Accounts Payable, ExHub Procurement, Master Data Management, General Ledger & Controlling, and Global IT, to ensure seamless end-to-end process execution.

Your profile:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
- Strong interest in procurement and a proactive, learning-oriented mindset.
- Proficiency in German and English; Spanish, Italian, French, or other EU languages are a plus;
- High affinity for IT tools, including very good Excel skills; knowledge of SAP CPH is a plus;
- Strong communication and organization skills.

Our offer:

- A supportive, collaborative, and appreciative working environment.
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (up to 40% home office) designed to fit around your studies.
- Attractive remuneration and valuable practical experience in an international Shared Service Center.
- The opportunity to develop professional skills and gain hands-on experience in a global procurement organization.
- Comprehensive insights into end-to-end Procurement and Accounts Payable processes through close cross-functional collaboration.
- A chance to build a strong foundation for your future career in Procurement and Supply Chain Management.

Interested? Then submit your application via our online application system SuccessFactors! Please click the “Apply” button.

Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Corteco is an internationally leading supplier in the open automotive replacement parts market. As a subsidiary of the global Freudenberg Group, we supply over 26,000 articles in OEM quality. In seals and vibration control technology as well as cabin air filters, this makes the product range of an original equipment manufacturer available to independent workshops and replacement parts dealers as well. Pinerolo - (TO)
Corteco GmbH

We are looking for a finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with accounting expertise, business acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset. Financial Analyst Group Reporting, Consolidation & Accounting Governance (f/m/d)

- Drive Process Excellence: Identify opportunities to improve reporting, closing, and governance processes through standardization, digitalization, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Extensive years of experience in group reporting, consolidation, financial controlling, accounting governance, or corporate finance within an international environment.
- Strong knowledge of IFRS, consolidation principles, financial reporting, month-end closing, provisions, accruals, and balance sheet management.
- Proven ability to analyze complex financial topics, challenge assumptions, and deliver high-quality results with accuracy and ownership.

- Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and finance transformation projects.
- Strong command of Excel, financial systems, and reporting tools; experience with HFM/Hyperion, Power BI, SAP BI, or similar platforms is an advantage.

jobs.description:

Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing awareness and adoption of Amazon Web Services by engaging with Public Sector organizations in Germany who are reinventing their IT strategy by adopting cloud computing? Do you have the business savvy, sales experience, and technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider?

As a Greenfield Account Executive within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS), you will build AWS adoption in net-new public sector accounts with limited or no existing AWS presence. You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, helping public sector organizations reinvent their IT strategy through cloud computing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in full sales cycle, technology sales, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent business development
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce
- Fluent in German and English with the ability to conduct sales and technical conversations with customers in both languages
- Experience developing and executing sales strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs
- Experience in generating new opportunities with strong focus on pipeline tracking and deal execution through entire sales cycle

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Associate level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with government procurement and contracting process
- Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements
- Experience selling nascent products and services Ability to drive solutions to difficult problems
- Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent

This role requires building a sales function from the ground up, demanding creative problem-solving, tenacity, and the ability to develop novel approaches for reaching and engaging prospective customers. You will establish business and technical relationships with public sector organizations, driving adoption of AWS services that transform how they deliver services to citizens and communities.

You will engage customers face-to-face and via teleconference, interacting at the CXO level in strategic accounts. The ideal candidate possesses both business acumen to drive executive-level engagements and technical knowledge to interact effectively with software developers and architects.

This position requires working from the local office when not at customer sites.

Sales Execution
• Prospect and qualify net-new public sector accounts with limited or no AWS presence
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
• Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets while maintaining robust pipeline coverage
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting in Salesforce

Customer Engagement

Public Sector Expertise

Collaboration

• Collaborate with the partner ecosystem (systems integrators, resellers, distributors) to drive customer success and extend market reach

A day in the life
You will balance hunting new accounts with nurturing early-stage relationships. Working with a team of German AE's to grow the Public Sector Greenfield business. You will spend time on prospecting, researching accounts, sourcing contacts, and executing outbound campaigns to generate meetings. jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Operations Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team in our site in Berlin.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and we are looking for a manager with experience in people leadership, a strong technical understanding of data center operations and infrastructure, and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations into the future.

The Data Center Manager is the leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed.

Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Technicians which is installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware

- Coordinate the shift work among the team and ensure 24 hours coverage available for our data centers
- Maintant on-call duties
- Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective
- Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams
- Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. jobs.occupation: 588035 Factory Project Manager (all genders) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As Project Manager BBN Factory, you will join the production and operations network of Philips' HPM manufacturing site in Böblingen and work closely with PIE, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facility Management and the shop floor. In this high-impact role, you will translate strategic industrialization objectives into operational execution, ensuring the successful and timely introduction of new products in an international environment. As a central coordinator between local and global stakeholders, you will directly contribute to the sustainable development and future readiness of the Böblingen site.

You will take end-to-end ownership of complex, production-related projects within the BBN Factory environment, ensuring on-time industrialization and new-product introduction. Acting as the key interface between Product Industrialization Engineering (PIE), Production Process Engineering, the shop floor and other Operations functions, you will coordinate production-line setups, machinery and system implementations, and cross-site initiatives—playing a decisive role in achieving critical NPI milestones.

This is an opportunity to shape how innovative patient-monitoring solutions move from industrialization into reliable production, influence a broad international stakeholder network and leave a visible, lasting impact on Philips' global manufacturing organization.

Please note: This is a fixed-term employment contract for 24 months.

Your Role:

- Job title:End-to-End Project Management: Plan, manage and execute multiple parallel production and industrialization projects in a manufacturing environment, including schedule, resource, cost and risk management.
- Interface & Stakeholder Management: Closely coordinate between PIE, Production Process Engineering, the shop floor, Facility Management, material supply, logistics, Production Management and operator resource management.
- QMS & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and Quality Management System processes, particularly in the medical-technology environment, and create, maintain and secure approval of relevant production-side project and process documentation.
- Supplier & Partner Management: Manage relevant internal and external project partners and work closely with Calibration, Maintenance and Technical Support teams.
- International Project Coordination: Lead and coordinate international projects across multiple HPM locations, particularly programs involving several sites within a global matrix organization.

You're the right fit if:

- You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, industrial management, or a related field.
- You have at least 5 years of experience leading manufacturing or industrialization projects across multiple workstreams.
- You have experience with quality systems and compliance in a regulated sector.
- You have practical knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured project management.
- You have experience coordinating global, cross-functional teams.
- You understand production processes, equipment, robotics, and NPI.
- You are able to influence without authority and drive actions.
- You have business-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written.
- You are able to deliver NPI, quality, and production-readiness milestones.
- You collaborate effectively across factory and operational functions.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €103,510.62 – €138,014.16. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others?
